correctness.rationale: The 16 length-15 linear-function codewords are affinely independent at squared separation 8. The centered Gram identity 4(I-J/16) reduces the nearest-polytope distance to a Euclidean probability-simplex projection of 16 barycentric coordinates b_a/16. KKT threshold t with sum_a(b_a-t)_+=16 determines a unique nearest point and an exact rational squared-distance formula. Independent complete integer enumeration over all 2^15=32768 cube corners reproduces exactly 13 levels, their count/support triples, 16 maximizers 49/15 (precisely complements of codewords) and 240 next-level neighbors 18/7. This is exhaustive for the explicitly finite domain, not an inference about arbitrary code sizes or continuous interior cube points.

originality.rationale: The assigned punctured linear simplex-code regular simplex and its complete 13-shell corner/nearest-face spectrum were compared at the statement and implication level with the unpunctured affine first-order Reed–Muller cross-polytope projection theorem, dual Hamming-code polytope results and coding LP/facet literature. The Reed–Muller result covers 16 coordinates and 32 affine codewords and gives Walsh projection and bent deep holes; removing the zero coordinate and all affine complements changes the codeword polytope and does not supply the 13 discrete shells, multiplicities and nearest-face supports. No known exact table was found; this is best-of-knowledge, not a priority certificate.
